title: ML-IAM: Machine Learning Emulator for Integrated Assessment Models - Source Code
description:
This repository contains the source code for ML-IAM, a machine learning emulator trained on the IPCC AR6 Scenarios Database to rapidly generate climate scenario projections. The repository includes complete source code for training and evaluating XGBoost, LSTM, and TFT models.

Related publication: ML-IAM v1.0: Emulating Integrated Assessment Models With Machine Learning

The IPCC AR6 Scenarios Database used for model training is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7197970
